about_the_game:
Trapped in a maze of secret alt accounts—you wanna escape?

The owner of the alt is waiting for you somewhere within: find them

and kill them ❤

❤ Story

The all-girl band Rag Drops is breaking out on social media with the vocalist of the century, Neon, taking the lead. But then ████████████. ██████████, “████” ███████████. Rag Drops is accused of heinous crimes.

“████████, it's your fault.”

The band is engulfed in an unprecedented firestorm. ███████―? Suspicion and doubt begin eating them alive when suddenly their smartphones begin to glow.

Welcome to the otherworld UraU, girls, where the dark side of social media materializes!

❤ What's up, chat! Like people, this game is two-faced! ❤

Side 1! Dungeon Exploration

If you wanna escape the manifestation of this secret alt account, you gotta survive the dungeon U. Slaughter malicious monsters infesting the alt and hunt down the Secret Alt's Owner waiting in the dungeon depths❤

Side 2! Twisty ADV Sections Chock Full of Secrets

The malicious dungeon belongs to one of the girls. Whose could it be...? Speculate wildly and give the guilty girl a public execution!

Let's watch the poor helpless girls, 'kay...? ❤

♥ Characters

Hino Neon

#███ #███ #███

CV: Arise Kanon

""If it doesn't resonate with you, you don't have to listen.""

A charismatic diva who commands a huge following with her bold attitude and unique sensibility. ████████████████. ██████████████████████████████████████████.

Birthday: ███

Obsession: ███

Secret alt: ███

Psyche Riiru

#DeathWish #Guitar #NeonBeliever

CV: Hoshizaki Kana

""I write a suicide note every day!""

A bright, vivacious girl fascinated with suicide. She has a strange idea of ""personal space"" and is happiest when others rely on her. She finds being needed comforting. Her childhood friends are Hino Neon and Ichinose Kairi.

Birthday: ███

Obsession: ███

Secret alt: ███

Ichinose Kairi

#Weakling #Guitar #F*ck

CV: Hina Madoka

""...I'm gonna kick some ass now... so listen up... you guys... (muttering)”

A self-declared strong woman. Extremely petite. She lashes out at everyone with a ton of aggression, but she's actually super frail and has a soft voice. After every live show she straight up collapses.

Birthday: ███

Obsession: ███

Secret alt: ███

Hazama Nagi

#SelfProclaimedPsychopath #Bass #Observer

CV: Saya Fukuzumi

""You tell me to say what I think, but then you're mad when I actually do?""

A contrary little tomboy who always goes against the grain. She's got an otherworldly vibe. She's always got an eye on everyone and a sarcastic edge when she speaks. She calls herself a psychopath and likes to say, ""I don't have emotions.""

Birthday: ███

Obsession: ███

Secret alt: ███

Kagura Kuroa

#Devotion #Drums #ToxicPositivity

CV: Kaede Kogaya

""Even Miss Angel says there's nothing to worry about ♪""

A gentle, kind-hearted girl. Her purpose in life is supporting others. She gets ten times more emotional about things than everyone else. She's always carrying a stuffy she calls ""Miss Angel"", and claims to hear Miss Angel's voice.

Birthday: ███

Obsession: ███

Secret alt: ███

Minazuki Meika

#Sparkle #Keyboard #Blessed

CV: Hiiragi Yuka

""If you're not following Meika, your life will be shadowbanned~? ♡""

A glamorous trendsetter always in the limelight. (Like!) She's always got at least four smartphones on her and juggles multiple social accounts. She's never not putting in the effort to look dazzling!

Birthday: ███

Obsession: ███

Secret alt: ███

Nikaido Hiro

#Guide #Justice #Memory

CV: Shinonome Haru

""I've seen plenty of lost souls like you before.""

A righteous girl who guides visitors through UraU. There's gossip that she was once involved in a very horrific incident. There's a bitter look on her face when she hears words like ""justice"", ""suicide"", and ""bullying"".

Birthday: January 10th

Complex: ███

Secret alt: ███

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPUs
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: All the information here may subject to change without prior notice.

name: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Generic Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Recent DirectX 11-capable GPUs (incl. Integrated Graphics)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan graphic API available via `-force-vulkan` argument for diagnosing purpose. All the information here may subject to change without prior notice.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64‑bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700 (8 cores / 16 threads)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Provisional information as per development validation. Subject to change in the future when further optimization is implemented

short_description: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of 魔法少女ノ魔女裁判, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.

Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English
*languages with full audio support
